title: Energy of butane as it rotates
caption: Rotating about the central C–C bond: the anti conformation (180°) is lowest; gauche (60°, 300°) is about 3.8 kJ mol⁻¹ higher; eclipsed forms are maxima, the fully eclipsed one (0°, methyls together) highest at about 19 kJ mol⁻¹.
alt: Energy against dihedral angle from 0 to 360 degrees: maxima at 0 and 360 (19 kJ/mol) and at 120 and 240 (about 15), minima at 60 and 300 (gauche, about 3.8) and at 180 (anti, 0).
description: Fully eclipsed at 0° and 360°: about 19 kJ mol⁻¹.
Gauche minima at 60° and 300°: about 3.8 kJ mol⁻¹.
Eclipsed maxima at 120° and 240°: about 15 kJ mol⁻¹.
